name: cube
description: Pass one length for all axes or [x, y, z] for independent dimensions. Centering places the origin at the middle of the box.

name: sphere
description: Creates a sphere centered at the origin. Choose a radius or a named diameter.

name: cylinder
signature: cylinder(h, r, center = false); or cylinder(h, r1, r2, center = false);
description: Creates a solid along Z. Set r1 and r2 for distinct bottom and top radii, or use named d, d1, and d2 for diameters.

name: square
description: Creates a filled shape in XY. Use a single side length or a vector [width, height].

name: circle
description: Creates a filled circle centered at the origin in XY. Choose a radius or a named diameter.

name: polygon
description: Fills an outline defined by XY points. Optional paths list point indices for the outer boundary and any holes.

name: text
signature: text(text, size, font, halign, valign, spacing, direction, language, script);
description: Creates 2D glyph outlines. Extrude the result to produce solid lettering. Font availability depends on the renderer.

name: translate
description: Moves its children by the given offsets in model coordinates.

name: rotate
signature: rotate([x, y, z]) child; or rotate(a = angle, v = axis) child;
description: Rotates about the origin. With a vector of angles, rotations apply about X, Y, then Z. Angles are in degrees.

name: scale
description: Multiplies coordinates by per-axis factors about the origin. A single factor applies uniformly.

name: mirror
description: Reflects its children through the plane passing through the origin with the given normal.

name: union
description: Combines its children into a single result. Separate components can remain when their geometry does not touch.

name: difference
description: Subtracts every later child from the first child. Extend through-cutters slightly beyond both faces to avoid coincident surfaces.

name: intersection
description: Keeps the region shared by all children. A child with no common overlap makes the result empty.

name: linear_extrude
signature: linear_extrude(height = h, center = false, twist = degrees, slices = n, scale = factor) child;
description: Extends a 2D profile into a solid along Z by default. Use twist in degrees and slices to control the height subdivisions.
example: linear_extrude(height = 24, twist = 55, slices = 36) square([12, 8], center = true);

name: rotate_extrude
description: Sweeps a 2D profile about Z. Keep the profile to one side of X = 0. The distance from that line becomes the sweep radius.
version: The angle parameter requires OpenSCAD 2019.05 or later.

name: offset
signature: offset(r = radius) child; or offset(delta = distance, chamfer = false) child;
description: Expands a 2D outline for positive values and shrinks it for negative ones. Use r for rounded expansion or delta for fixed-distance edges.

name: projection
description: Projects 3D children onto XY. Set cut = true for the cross-section at Z = 0.

name: hull
description: Builds the convex envelope around its children. Use two circles to construct a capsule-shaped profile.

name: minkowski
description: Computes the geometric sum of its children. A sphere rounds a solid while increasing its outer dimensions by the sphere diameter.

name: include
description: Includes source at the directive, making its definitions and variables available and evaluating top-level geometry.

name: use
description: Makes the referenced modules and functions callable. The caller gains neither the file's variables nor its top-level geometry.

name: Tessellation settings
description: Set $fn to a fragment count of at least 3 for a full circle. With $fn = 0, $fa and $fs guide angular and size-based resolution.

name: Customizer annotations
signature: /* [Group] */ followed by a top-level literal assignment and // [min:step:max]
description: Place editable literal parameters before modules and functions. Group them with a block comment and add slider ranges or choices with line comments.
version: The upstream OpenSCAD Customizer requires 2019.05 or later.
